test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: PETA India started in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) India** was founded in **2000 **with the simple belief that animals are not ours to eat, wear, experiment on, or use for entertainment.
 
• PETA India has greatly improved the quality of life for many animals and saved the lives of countless more through investigative and legislative work, public education, animal rescues, eye-catching demonstrations, celebrity involvement, and outreach with our youth division, PETA Youth.
 
• PETA India is a not-for-profit business incorporated under **Section 25 of the Companies Act, 1956**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ingrid Newkirk, **the international president of People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals, is an American animal rights group based in Norfolk, Virginia. 
 
• PETA claims to have more than 9 million members and sympathisers around the world. **"Animals are not ours to experiment on, eat, wear, exploit for entertainment, or harm in any other manner," **the organization's slogan says.
 
• Ingrid Newkirk and fellow animal rights activist Alex Pacheco founded the organisation in March 1980, and it first gained national prominence in the summer of 1981 during the Silver Spring monkeys case.
